changelog:
Changes since `v0.1.1-beta`:

### ✨ New Features

- transform into universal Anime Kai & Fan-Edits plugin supporting Re:Zero, One Pace, Naruto Kai, Bleach Kai, and Consumet HLS Gateway ([2aef3c1](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/2aef3c1))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **kai:** route Naruto Kai and Bleach Kai defaults through consumet-proxy HLS ([bbab8f9](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/bbab8f9))
- **animekai:** optimize stream loading, fix artwork and integrate consumet-proxy v0.2.2.0 ([c1de967](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/c1de967))
- eliminate AngleSharp dependency, add native Next.js One Pace parser, and suppress placeholder image errors ([4b68e5c](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/4b68e5c))
- **rezero:** support both and clean in SelectRelativeSourcePath ([bcf3988](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/bcf3988))

### 📚 Documentation

- add clear HTTPS direct download and zero torrents notice in config UI ([fd60574](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/fd60574))

### 🔧 Maintenance

- update repository links to FaserF/animekai-jellyfin and fix release manifest zip path ([d201283](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/d201283))
- **deps:** update dependency anglesharp to 1.10.5 ([7addd90](https://github.com/FaserF/animekai-jellyfin/commit/7addd90))
